name: Control Surface Layouts
author: Freek van Gool
description: Layouts for the Control Surface. The Controllers folder holds layouts of well-known MIDI controllers together with their MIDI mapping (names of products are used here only to say which controller a mapping is for); the other folders hold generic shapes (strips of knobs, faders and buttons, banks of faders, knob grids and pad grids). Where a preset has no mapping, assign the elements to your own controller with Learn.
